topic: Diderot: a preprint server for partly AI-generated papers

messages.content:
Hi,

I previously shared a prototype of a preprint server for partly AI-generated papers (here) -- a kind of crossover between arXiv and https://www.erdosproblems.com. I received positive response from others within the mathematical community, so I continued developing the website.

You’re very welcome to start uploading writeups to https://projectdiderot.com. Of course, feedback is still very much appreciated (whether in DM or this thread). Also, if you want to be more involved, please do let me know. Thank you!
